compatibility_rationale: Plan ARIA-V10.3-B prerequisite. Operator enabled 5 of the 6 originally-targeted protection rules: required_signatures.enabled=true (V3.1-B-3 git verify-commit anchor), required_status_checks.strict=true (HIGH-002 up-to-date), enforce_admins.enabled=true (CRIT-002 admin bypass), required_pull_request_reviews.required_approving_review_count=1, required_linear_history.enabled=true. The 6th — restrictions.users (push restriction list) — did not surface in GitHub's classic Branch Protection UI for this Free-plan public repo. Operator confirmed snowball is the ARIA experimental branch (per CLAUDE.md ARIA Snowball policy) where push restriction is overkill; the remaining 5 Tier-1 rules + ARIA V3 defense-in-depth (AutoActionGate, circuit breaker, cost budget, cross-host lease lock, ack-ledger HMAC, three-event materialize chain) deliver the trust floor. preflight.REQUIRED_BRANCH_PROTECTION_FIELDS amended from 4 to 3 entries (signatures + strict + enforce_admins) to align with operator-acknowledged scope.
